title: Copper API review: contact caps and 180 a minute
snippet:
Requests are limited to 180 a minute on a rolling window, the same on every plan that has the API. What the plan changes is how many contacts you may store: 2,500 on Basic, 15,000 on Professional, unlimited on Business.

Copper API pricing is seat pricing: the API comes with the subscription, and the plan you choose sets the contact cap rather than the request rate.
### Basic
$23
/seat/mo billed annually, $29 month to month
- 2,500 contact limit
- Pipelines and task automation
- Contact enrichment
### Professional
$59
/seat/mo billed annually, $69 month to month
- 15,000 contact limit
- Workflow automation, bulk email and reporting
- Integrations
### Business
$99
/seat/mo billed annually, $134 month to month
- Unlimited contacts
- Email series and custom reports
- Multi-currency and premium support
Annual billing takes up to 26% off, and every plan starts with a free trial; there is no free tier after it. Copper says 63% of customers start on Professional, which is also the first plan whose card lists integrations. Its feature comparison names the API and embedded integration SDK as a feature, but the capture read for this review does not show which plans carry it, so confirm the plan before building.

- No free tier after the trial, and no MCP server yet: Copper's read-only Claude beta is due in November 2026.

Is the Copper API free?
No free tier. Free trial, and annual billing takes up to 26% off. Paid plans start at $23/seat/mo annual.
How much does the Copper API cost?
Copper starts at $23/seat/mo annual. It bills per seat, by subscription. Read from Copper's own pricing page on 24 October 2026.

title: Pricing | Copper Analytics
snippet:
Copper is a side project that tracks side projects. It is built to run on free hosting tiers, so there is nothing to charge for.
## Hosted
$0
- Up to 10 projects per account
- Up to 5,000 pageviews a day per project
- Hourly numbers for 14 days, daily totals kept for good
- Page, referrer and country breakdowns for 25 months
- Share links, CSV export and a read-only API
[Sign in with GitHub](https://app.copperanalytics.com)
Pageviews past a project's daily limit are not counted. Need more room? Write to [hello@copperanalytics.com](mailto:hello@copperanalytics.com).
## Self-hosted
$0
- No limits beyond your own hardware
- One command with Docker, or Node and any Postgres
- The same dashboard, tracker and API
- MIT licensed
[Read the self-hosting guide](https://github.com/masaok/copper-analytics/blob/main/docs/SELF_HOSTING.md)
